none: PAS CAM-E42707: Roman Coin : Nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine. Mint is uncertain, c.330-335, Reece period 17. Obverse shows bust right. Obverse legend is illegible. Reverse shows two soldiers, two standards. Reverse legend reads [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //[...]. Die axis is 6 o'clock, weight is 0.78g, diameter is 15mm
